offering_description.value: Operates business-to-business trade shows, conferences and events across many industries, selling exhibit space, sponsorships and attendee registrations. Also provides year-round digital marketing and content to connect exhibitors and buyers. Runs events mainly in the US and some international markets.

primary_services.value: trade show and event organizing; exhibit space and sponsorship sales; conferences; digital marketing and content for exhibitors

customer_segment.value: B2B: exhibitors, sponsors and professional attendees from industry companies and retailers

end_markets.value: retail and design; jewelry; sports and outdoor; cannabis; hospitality; healthcare; manufacturing and packaging

revenue_model.value: service fees: exhibit space rental, attendee registrations and conference fees; other: sponsorships and marketing programs sold to exhibitors and brands

value_chain_position.value: service provider: organizes and runs events, selling space and sponsorships to exhibitors and sellers, with attendees from industry buyers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States events, with some international events, including in Asia and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: trade shows across multiple industries plus conferences and digital marketing services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling booths and sponsorships to exhibitors; online: online registration and digital marketing platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules plus venue, health and safety, and data privacy rules

notes: Event portfolio and international footprint may have changed; details based on general knowledge.
